roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center. This vital role involves overseeing staff education and ensuring robust infection prevention and control measures are in place to maintain a safe and healthy environment for both residents and staff. You will play a key role in developing and implementing training programs, conducting surveillance, and ensuring compliance with all relevant healthcare regulations. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Registered Nurse to make a significant impact within a supportive team environment. We offer a competitive hourly rate and the chance to contribute to a facility committed to high standards of care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
